seo.title: Menu
seo.description: Small plates, sushi and sashimi, robata-grilled skewers, rice and noodles, and a considered sake list at Izakaya WA in Houston.

hero.title: The menu
hero.intro: An izakaya menu is meant to be shared. Order a few plates, pass them around, and add more as the evening goes on.

image.alt: Close-up of freshly made nigiri sushi

notice.label: Please note:
notice.text: our kitchen cooks seasonally and the printed menu changes often, so the dishes below are a representative guide rather than a fixed list. Call either location for today's menu and current pricing.

sections.title: Small Plates
sections.blurb: The heart of an izakaya. Order a few, share them all, and let the table fill up as the evening goes on.

dishes.name: Edamame
dishes.description: Steamed young soybeans finished with flaky sea salt.

dishes.name: Agedashi Tofu
dishes.description: Silken tofu in a light potato-starch crust, served in warm dashi with scallion and bonito.

dishes.name: Shiso-Marinated Jellyfish
dishes.description: Chilled jellyfish dressed with perilla leaf and sesame — clean, crisp and bright.

dishes.name: Tako Kara Age
dishes.description: Crisp-fried octopus with a squeeze of lemon and house salt.

dishes.name: Potato Croquettes
dishes.description: Golden korokke, creamy inside, served with tonkatsu sauce.

dishes.name: Gyoza
dishes.description: Pan-seared pork dumplings with a lacy crisp skirt.

dishes.name: Chawanmushi
dishes.description: Delicate steamed egg custard with dashi and seasonal garnish.

dishes.name: Hamachi Carpaccio
dishes.description: Thin-sliced yellowtail with serrano pepper, citrus and olive oil.

sections.title: Sushi & Sashimi
sections.blurb: Cut to order by our sushi chefs, with fish selected for the day's board.

dishes.name: Nigiri Selection
dishes.description: Two pieces per order — salmon, tuna, yellowtail, shrimp and more.

dishes.name: Sashimi Platter
dishes.description: Chef's selection of the day, sliced and plated simply.

dishes.name: Hamachi (Yellowtail)
dishes.description: Buttery yellowtail, a house favorite.

image.alt: Slices of sashimi plated with a dipping sauce

dishes.name: Memorial Roll
dishes.description: Our signature roll, named for the Memorial Drive dining room.

image.alt: Close-up of freshly made nigiri sushi

dishes.name: Crunchy Shrimp Roll
dishes.description: Crisp shrimp, avocado and a light drizzle of sauce.

dishes.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
dishes.description: Chopped tuna with chili and scallion.

dishes.name: Sushi Combo
dishes.description: A composed set of nigiri and a roll — a good way to start.

sections.title: From the Grill
sections.blurb: Skewers and grilled plates cooked over the fire — ask what's on the grill tonight.

dishes.name: Pork Belly
dishes.description: Charred, unctuous and salted — the most-ordered skewer.

image.alt: Grilled yakitori skewers on a plate

dishes.name: Chicken Thigh Yakitori
dishes.description: Glazed with tare or seasoned with salt.

dishes.name: Japanese Sausage
dishes.description: Snappy grilled sausage, sliced for sharing.

dishes.name: Beef Tongue
dishes.description: Gyutan skewers, tender and smoky.

dishes.name: Grilled Whole Squid
dishes.description: Ika brushed with sweet soy and grilled to order.

dishes.name: Grilled Fish
dishes.description: Whole fish grilled simply and served with grated daikon.

image.alt: A whole fish grilled and served on a plate

dishes.name: Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus
dishes.description: Crisp asparagus wrapped in smoky bacon.

dishes.name: Shiitake Mushroom
dishes.description: Grilled mushrooms with a touch of soy.

sections.title: Rice & Noodles
sections.blurb: Hearty plates to round out the table.

dishes.name: Katsu Curry Rice
dishes.description: Crisp pork cutlet over rice with our house Japanese curry.

image.alt: A rice bowl topped with sliced pork

dishes.name: Pork Chashu Don
dishes.description: Braised pork over steamed rice with scallion.

dishes.name: Udon
dishes.description: Thick wheat noodles in a warm dashi broth.

dishes.name: Onigiri
dishes.description: Hand-shaped rice balls with a savory filling.

dishes.name: Miso Soup
dishes.description: Daily miso with tofu, wakame and scallion.

dishes.name: Matcha Ice Cream
dishes.description: Stone-ground green tea, bittersweet and cool.

dishes.name: Mochi Ice Cream
dishes.description: Chewy mochi wrapped around ice cream.

dishes.name: Black Sesame Pudding
dishes.description: Silky goma purin with a toasted-sesame aroma.

sections.title: Sake & Drinks
sections.blurb: Drinks matter as much as the food here. Ask your server about the current sake flight.

dishes.name: Sake Flight
dishes.description: A guided tasting of three sakes, chosen by the house.

image.alt: Bottles of sake lined up on a shelf

dishes.name: Junmai · Ginjo · Daiginjo
dishes.description: By the glass or the bottle, from crisp to fragrant.

dishes.name: Shochu Highball
dishes.description: Shochu and soda, bright and easy — a classic izakaya drink.

dishes.name: Japanese Beer
dishes.description: Asahi, Sapporo and Kirin, ice cold.

dishes.name: Japanese Whisky
dishes.description: Neat, on the rocks, or as a highball.

dishes.name: Umeshu
dishes.description: Sweet-sour plum wine, served chilled.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.intro: Tell us what you like and we'll build a course for the table — a few small plates, something from the grill, and a sake to match.
